newsitem.title: USA: Merrill names new chief economist.
newsitem.headline: Merrill names new chief economist.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co said Monday it has named Bruce Steinberg the firm's chief economist.

Most recently, Steinberg served as manager of macroeconomic analysis for Merrill Lynch. As the firm's chief economist, he will be its primary economic spokesman and will be responsible for its U.S. economic forecast.
Steinberg succeeds Donald Straszheim, who is leaving Merrill Lynch to become president of the Milken Institute for Job and Capital Formation, an economic and policy institute in Santa Monica, Calif.
Merrill Lynch said it also has named James Winder manager of global economics.
